language_scope.out_of_scope_policy: Flag non-English, mixed-language, or uncertain speech for review; do not silently classify it as English.

classification_taxonomy.target_speaker_policy: Use a speaker label only when the target is supported by transcript/context; otherwise null.
classification_taxonomy.inference_policy: Observable timing/order is not by itself proof of conversational intent. Use transcript evidence and abstain when evidence is insufficient.

notes: This is a separate analytical artifact.
final.json and overlap_followup_analysis.json are not modified.
Cluster A is analyzed across all sequential speaker transitions, not only overlaps.
Cluster A candidates are structural and require contextual confirmation.
Clusters B-G are based on overlap interaction events.
D/E floor outcomes should be interpreted cautiously; timing alone does not prove interruption success.
Unclassified events are preserved rather than forced into a cluster.

topic_modeling.description: Topics, subtopics, assignments, distribution, timeline, and drift from topic-modeling artifact.

topic_interaction_analysis.note: Requires topic-segment timestamps aligned to overlap/interruption events. No causal claim is made by this script.

host_identification.description: Host identity, top candidates, and evidence.

host_actions.description: Host action classification; inspect completion/failure and label distributions before interpreting.

host_participation.note: Host participation can be computed once the host identity is verified against speaker IDs.

interruption_management.description: Host handling of interruptions, if produced.

speaker_interaction_analysis.note: Requires validated event-level speaker roles; transition counts alone do not establish interaction function.

validation_and_data_quality.warning: A source file being present does not imply its classification completed successfully; inspect its own status fields.

methodology_and_configuration.transition_definition: Adjacent turns from different speakers in chronological order.
methodology_and_configuration.principle: Computed values are distinguished from unavailable, pending, or source-preserved analyses. No causal interpretation is inferred.
